description.value:
Shadow Possession Technique. The Nara clan's signature. Your shadow snakes along the ground toward a target creature within 30 feet and binds itself to theirs.

Choose one creature in range with a shadow. The target attempts a Will save against your spell DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is off-guard until the start of your next turn.

Failure Until the end of your next turn, the target is forced to mirror your physical movements (Stride, prone/stand, hand gestures). The target cannot Strike or cast jutsu while bound; if you spend an action to move, they spend the same action to move the same direction (within their own Speed). You must Sustain to extend this effect each subsequent round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 minute and the target's MAP carries over to their next action after the binding ends.

Range and duration both scale with available ambient light. In total darkness the jutsu fails automatically; in bright light range increases to 60 feet.

system.requirements: you can see the target's shadow
